name: Mote Attractor
desc: An arcane structure, tips and curves and mesh and more, tickling the space around with electrostatic discharge and breaching p-space with small, careless holes. Through this, dots, motes, particles follow through, playfully singing and dancing and crying out for those that are kind enough to listen.

name: Ballet House
desc: From the depths of the abyss comes a hunger. And with a hunger, comes a maw. Carelessly thrown in, maintenance workers enter for their eternal dance, never to be seen again, all for the pleasure of song, dance, art, and love.
